mapper.select: SELECT HIST_ID , ENTITY_TYPE , TABLE_NM , ENTITY_ID , ACTION_TYPE , ACTOR_ID , ACTOR_NM , REASON , REQ_IP , TRACE_ID , CHANGED_AT FROM HIST_EVENT WHERE ENTITY_TYPE = #{entity_type} AND ENTITY_ID = #{entity_id} ORDER BY CHANGED_AT DESC, HIST_ID DESC

SELECT E.HIST_ID , E.ENTITY_TYPE , E.TABLE_NM , E.ENTITY_ID , E.ACTION_TYPE , E.ACTOR_ID , E.ACTOR_NM , E.REASON , E.REQ_IP , E.TRACE_ID , E.CHANGED_AT , S.BEFORE_DATA , S.AFTER_DATA FROM HIST_EVENT E LEFT JOIN HIST_SNAPSHOT S ON S.HIST_ID = E.HIST_ID WHERE E.HIST_ID = #{value}
